import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Set random seed for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# Paths
INPUT_PATH = "./input"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_PATH, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_PATH, "test.csv")
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_CSV = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_PATH, "submission.csv")

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_PATH, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Identify columns
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"
X_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c != target_col and c != id_col]
y_cols = [target_col]

X_train_full = train_df[X_cols]
y_train_full = train_df[target_col]
X_test_full = test_df[X_cols]
test_ids = test_df[id_col]

# Split training data to create hold-out validation set
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=RANDOM_STATE, shuffle=True
)

# Preprocess data - identify and mark categorical features
# Wilderness_Area columns are categorical - mark them as categorical features for LightGBM
wilderness_cols = [col for col in X_cols if "Wilderness_Area" in col]

# Ensure Wilderness_Area columns are integer type (they appear to be ordinal encoded)
for col in wilderness_cols:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype("category")
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].astype("category")
    X_train_full[col] = X_train_full[col].astype("category")
    X_test_full[col] = X_test_full[col].astype("category")

# Initialize LightGBM model with categorical features specified
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    num_leaves=20,
    max_depth=5,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    categorical_feature=wilderness_cols,
)

print("Training model...")
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy}")

# Predict on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test_full)

# Prepare submission file
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred.astype(int)})

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_CSV, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_CSV}")
